name: Castiello de Jaca (Spain)
description: Red field with a blue triangle edged white with its base along the hoist and its apex at the fly, charged with a yellow church.
history: Municipal flag of Castiello de Jaca; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle edged white with concave sides, its base along the hoist and its apex at the fly
